name: Bind
description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is grappled, you may continue this move, as a bonus action, to do an automatic 1d4 {type} damage without having to make an attack roll.
